[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 1/10[-] | 进度与游戏阶段

English: [FFD700]PROGRESSION & GAME STAGE[-] AEC difficulty follows your real Game Stage (GS), not only your character level. T00-T04 cover the pre-endgame grades: Basic, Feral, Radiated, Charged and Infernal. The full endgame route begins at GS 600 with T05 Veteran, then advances through T06 Brutal, T07 Savage, T08 Ravager, T09 Dread, T10 Nightmare, T11 Apex, T12 Overlord, T13 Titan, T14 Cataclysm and T15 Mythic. Higher tiers increase health, damage, speed, mobility and rewards. Check the AEC skill-tree tab for your current GS thresholds. Quests can force a precise tier inside their active POI; outside quests, wilderness selection remains dynamic.
schinese: [FFD700]进度与游戏阶段[-] AEC难度依据真实游戏阶段（GS），而不只看角色等级。T00至T04依次为基础、凶暴、辐射、充能和炼狱。完整终局路线从GS600的T05老兵开始，继续提升至T15神话。等级越高，生命、伤害、速度、机动性和奖励越高。任务可在活动兴趣点内部强制指定等级，外部荒野仍采用动态选择。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 2/10[-] | 新手保护

English: Read how AEC protects players below GS 100 and GS 600.
schinese: 阅读AEC对GS100和GS600以下玩家的保护机制。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 2/10[-] | 新手保护

English: [50DC50]NEWBIE PROTECTION[-] At GS 0-99, full newbie protection is active: dangerous AEC events do not directly target you, their nearby-spawn effects are blocked for you, and Heatmap or Storm Hazard boosts are ignored by your surrounding wilderness spawns. Kills may still be recorded by the world systems, but you are not selected as their dangerous target. At GS 100-599, the absolute newbie shield has ended, yet the AEC T05+ wilderness tier route is still locked: boosted Game Stage from Heatmap or Storm cannot promote your normal wilderness spawns into the GS 600 endgame ladder. Heat can still build and Hazard can still rise for the biome, but Heatmap bosses and Nemesis appearances require an eligible player at GS 600 or higher.
schinese: [50DC50]新手保护[-] GS0至99时启用完整保护：危险AEC事件不会直接选择你，附近生成也不会受到热度或风暴危险加成。GS100至599时绝对保护结束，但普通荒野仍无法进入GS600以上的T05+路线；首领热度事件和宿敌现身需要至少一名GS600玩家。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 3/10[-] | 热度压力

English: Read the current Heatmap gain, decay, warning and cooldown rules.
schinese: 阅读当前热度的增加、衰减、警告和冷却规则。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 3/10[-] | 热度压力

English: [64B4FF]HEATMAP PRESSURE[-] The active system tracks combat pressure by biome. Every eligible zombie kill adds 1% Heat. After 60 real seconds without a kill, Heat decays by 5% per real minute. Players are warned at 70%; reaching 100% primes the next escalation. The 64-metre cell setting is used for local density and follower-overcrowding checks, not as the scope of the biome-wide Hazard level. Nearby feedback appears through Safe Zone, Heat and Hazard HUD buffs. A completed escalation chain has a 60-minute restart cooldown. Heatmap boss events remain separate from Blood Moon logic. Staying and fighting keeps pressure high; leaving combat quiet allows it to cool.
schinese: [64B4FF]热度压力[-] 每次有效击杀使所在生物群系热度增加1%。连续60秒没有击杀后，每现实分钟降低5%。70%时发出警告，100%时准备下一次升级。完成升级链后有60分钟重启冷却。持续战斗会维持压力，停止战斗可让热度冷却。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 4/10[-] | 危险0至5

English: Read how Heatmap escalation changes biome danger from Hazard 0 to 5.
schinese: 阅读热度升级如何将生物群系危险度从0提高到5。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 4/10[-] | 危险0至5

English: [FF8800]HAZARD ESCALATION[-] Hazard 0 means Heat is building but no biome tier boost is active. Each successful 100% Heat cycle raises the biome by one Hazard level and can arm a boss with 4 escorts. At GS 100-599, Heat and Hazard may accumulate, but the boosted-GS wilderness route is blocked and no protected low-GS player is chosen as the boss target. From GS 600 onward, that block is removed: repeated Heat cycles can keep increasing the biome without another GS gate, one level at a time, up to the hard limit Hazard 5. Each Hazard step can promote ordinary wilderness spawns above their normal GS tier. When Heat reaches zero and the biome remains quiet for at least five minutes, Hazard can fall one level. Hazard 5 is maximum pressure: relocate, cool the biome or fortify.
schinese: [FF8800]危险升级[-] 危险0表示热度正在积累但尚未强化生物群系。每次热度达到100%可使危险等级提高一级，并可能生成带4名护卫的首领。GS600后可逐级升至危险5。热度归零且区域安静至少5分钟后，危险等级可下降一级。危险5为最高压力。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 5/10[-] | 动态生成

English: Read how wilderness, POI, biome, Storm and Blood Moon spawning differ.
schinese: 阅读荒野、兴趣点、生物群系、风暴和血月生成机制的差异。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 5/10[-] | 动态生成

English: [FFD700]DYNAMIC SPAWNING[-] The AEC controller enhances vanilla spawning instead of replacing it blindly. It evaluates context, real GS, biome and day or night, then chooses an eligible weighted tier and family. Wilderness encounters may form leader-and-follower packs; followers can be weaker than their leader. Current safeguards suppress custom pressure within 100 metres of a Land Claim Block and stop follower injection when the local 3x3 cell neighborhood exceeds 15 zombies. Pine Forest remains the T05-T15 safe biome. During an active AEC quest, tier override applies only to the active POI clear phases; the outside world remains dynamic. Storm spawning is enabled in the shipped settings and adds one tier step where valid. Blood Moon uses separate scaling and boss rules.
schinese: [FFD700]动态生成[-] AEC会根据真实GS、生物群系、昼夜和当前环境强化原版生成。领地石100米范围内会抑制自定义压力，本地3×3单元超过15只僵尸时停止追加跟随者。松树林是T05至T15安全生物群系。任务等级覆盖只在活动兴趣点清剿阶段生效；风暴和血月采用各自规则。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 6/10[-] | AI世界事件

English: Read how biome invasions and the AI Master event schedule work.
schinese: 阅读生物群系入侵与AI主控事件日程的运作方式。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 6/10[-] | AI世界事件

English: [FFCC33]AI WORLD EVENTS[-] The AI Master schedules world pressure with a random 60-120 real-minute delay between selections. Events can target a biome, run for a limited window and sometimes migrate when they end. Active families include Doomlord, Singerie, Druid, night-only Ghost, Mushroom, Headless and Archer invasions, plus Mega-Horde, Heatmap increase or decrease, Ghost-on-kill pressure and boss incursions. The shipped rules disable Kill Replacement and multiplied-airdrop events by assigning them zero weight. Event and Nemesis clocks pause while no living player is connected; their deadlines shift when players return, preventing an instant backlog. GS 0-99 players are not dangerous-event targets. Treat server messages and HUD warnings as operational intelligence, not decoration.
schinese: [FFCC33]AI世界事件[-] AI主控每隔60至120现实分钟随机选择一次世界压力事件。事件可针对生物群系、限时运行并在结束时迁移。服务器无人存活在线时，事件与宿敌计时会暂停。GS0至99玩家不会成为危险事件目标。请认真对待服务器消息和HUD警告。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 7/10[-] | 宿敌名册

English: Read about persistent Nemesis identities, ranks, progression and death.
schinese: 阅读宿敌的持久身份、等级、成长和死亡机制。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 7/10[-] | 宿敌名册

English: [FF3333]NEMESIS ROSTER[-] Nemesis are persistent world-level AEC enemies, not disposable random bosses. Each record stores a unique name, title, rank, linked family and tier, home territory, combat history and virtual health, attack, defense and speed. Six ranks form the hierarchy: Lesser, Greater, Elite, Champion, Legendary and World. Victories, defeats and simulation conflicts can change their standing over time. Death is not always permanent: each Nemesis rolls its own permanent-removal threshold between 2 and 5 deaths, and death or despawn starts a respawn cooldown. Empty roster slots are refilled under population rules rather than instantly. Their state is saved to JSON, so identities, ranks, territories, grudges and death history survive world reloads.
schinese: [FF3333]宿敌名册[-] 宿敌是会长期存在的世界级AEC敌人。记录包含独特姓名、称号、等级、系列、层级、领地、战斗历史和虚拟属性。等级分为低阶、高阶、精英、冠军、传奇和世界级。每个宿敌需死亡2至5次才会永久移除，全部状态保存到JSON并跨世界重载保留。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 8/10[-] | 宿敌战争与迁移

English: Read about Nemesis grudges, revenge, territory wars and migration.
schinese: 阅读宿敌的仇恨、复仇、领地战争和迁移机制。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 8/10[-] | 宿敌战争与迁移

English: [FF8800]GRUDGES, WARS & MIGRATION[-] Defeating a Nemesis can create a personal grudge; killing a related ordinary AEC boss can also provoke family vengeance. Revenge checks are timed and pair-cooldown protected, while recently respawned players receive anti-chain protection. Nemesis can fight one another in power struggles and scheduled territory wars. Related allies may intervene and add simulation boosts; winners can rise, losers can fall, and titles may change with rank. Territory wars continue to resolve in the world, but players below GS 600 cannot trigger a Nemesis appearance by entering a territory or war zone. Nemesis can migrate their home coordinates over long intervals, so an old safe route may later cross a hostile domain. Names, titles and rank-colored HUD auras identify the threat when one is nearby.
schinese: [FF8800]仇恨、战争与迁移[-] 击败宿敌或相关AEC 首领可能触发个人仇恨与家族复仇。宿敌会进行权力斗争和领地战争，胜者晋升、败者降级，称号也可能改变。GS600以下玩家无法通过进入领地触发宿敌现身。宿敌会长期迁移，因此旧有安全路线也可能进入敌对领地。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 9/10[-] | 契约与代币

English: Read how trader contracts, POI sizes, tier overrides and tokens work.
schinese: 阅读商人契约、兴趣点规模、等级覆盖与代币机制。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 9/10[-] | 契约与代币

English: [5599FF]CONTRACTS & TOKENS[-] Trader AEC contracts combine an enemy tier T00-T15 with a POI size A1-A5. Activate the rally point, clear the sleepers, remain inside the POI and return to a trader. During clear phases, the listed AEC tier is forced only inside that POI. Completion awards universal AEC Tokens and tier-scaled rewards; higher tiers and larger objectives award more Tokens. Trader availability follows trader tier and game stage.\n\nThe 419-step AEC EO campaign covers Minion and Boss families from 0★ through 5★, including Research Papers, passive sample miners and the final T15 A5 challenge. The Contract Relay provides a renewable daily list of Boss and Minion contracts and can resummon its drone after a chunk unload.
schinese: [5599FF]契约与代币[-] AEC商人契约会将T00至T15的敌人等级与A1至A5的兴趣点规模组合起来。激活集结点，清除沉睡者，留在兴趣点范围内完成任务，然后返回商人处交付。执行清剿阶段时，标注的AEC敌人等级只会在该兴趣点内部生效。完成契约可获得通用AEC代币以及随等级提高的奖励；敌人等级越高、目标区域越大，获得的代币就越多。商人是否提供相应契约取决于商人等级和游戏阶段。\n\nAEC EO战役共包含419个步骤，涵盖从0★到5★的仆从与首领系列，包括研究论文、被动样本采集器以及最终的T15 A5挑战。契约中继站每天都会提供一组可重复获取的首领与仆从契约；区块卸载后，它还可以重新召唤无人机。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 10/10[-] | 样本、市场与装备

English: Read the AEC crafting economy from kill rewards to endgame mutators.
schinese: 阅读从击杀奖励到终局变异器的AEC制造经济。
[66B3FF]AEC野外指南 10/10[-] | 样本、市场与装备

English: [D9B36C]SAMPLES, MARKET & GEAR[-] Credited AEC kills award tiered mutation samples and Infected Teeth directly to the player. Completed AEC contracts award universal AEC Tokens. Use the Mutation Exchange to upgrade five samples into one sample of the next tier, or downgrade one sample into five of the previous tier.\n\nThe Zombie Market Terminal is the economy hub: request a Crypto Miner, power it with the correct battery, install family and star Connection Cards, produce boss coins, then invest those coins in Research Papers, Passive Part Miners, contracts and supplies. The AEC Extreme Workstation and Necroforge use universal Tokens and tiered mutation samples for endgame modifiers and equipment. Blood Moon ranking rewards remain personal, while Heatmap boss events are handled separately.
schinese: [D9B36C]样本、市场与装备[-] 有效的AEC击杀会直接给予玩家分级变异样本和感染者牙齿；完成AEC契约会获得AEC通用代币。变异样本兑换台可用五份样本合成一份下一等级样本，也可将一份样本分解为五份上一等级样本。\n\n僵尸市场终端是经济系统的核心：申请加密货币矿机，装入正确的电池和对应系列、星级的连接卡来生产首领硬币，再将硬币投入研究论文、被动部件采集器、契约与补给。AEC极限工作站和死灵锻炉使用通用代币及分级变异样本制造终局改装件与装备。血月排名奖励归个人所有，热度首领事件则单独结算。

schinese: [00FF66]每个等级先从小型兴趣点开始，最后挑战超大型兴趣点。[-]

English: [FF3333]T15 Mythic hits ~10x harder than T05. Scale your gear accordingly[-]
schinese: [FF3333]T15神话级的攻击伤害约为T05的10倍，请相应提升装备。[-]

English: Killing in biomes raises your Hazard level (1 to 5)
schinese: 在生物群系中击杀僵尸会提高该区域的危险等级（1至5）。

English: Higher Hazard = denser packs and higher zombie grades
schinese: 危险等级越高，怪群越密集，出现的僵尸等级也越高。

English: [FF3333]Hazard 5: mass convergence — evacuate or fortify immediately[-]
schinese: [FF3333]危险5：即将发生大规模集结，请立即撤离或加固防线。[-]

English: XP: up to [FFCC33]750,000 XP[-] (T15 A5) | 3 loot slots per contract
schinese: 经验：最高[FFCC33]750,000点[-]（T15 A5）| 每份契约3个战利品栏位
[FFD700]── AEC装备与掉落 ──[-]
AEC装备采用[FFCC33]武器、工具或护甲变异改装件[-]的形式。

English: Materials sources: boss and high-tier zombie kills | quests | misc loot

[FFD700]── 变异样本与兑换 ──[-]

schinese: 使用[FFCC33]变异样本兑换台[-]升级或降级不同等级的[8EBE67]变异样本[-]。

English: Credited AEC kills grant samples automatically; enemy grade determines their tier and amount.
schinese: 有效的AEC击杀会自动给予样本；敌人等级决定样本的等级和数量。

English: Use [FFD700]universal AEC Tokens[-] and [8EBE67]mutation samples[-] in recipes, upgrades and progression.
schinese: 在配方、升级和进度中使用[FFD700]AEC通用代币[-]与[8EBE67]变异样本[-]。

English: [00FF66]Five samples upgrade into one of the next tier; one sample downgrades into five of the previous tier.[-]
schinese: [00FF66]五份样本可升级为一份下一等级样本；一份样本可降级为五份上一等级样本。[-]

English: A pool of [FF3333]named nemesis[-] bosses lives in your world simultaneously
schinese: 你的世界中会同时存在一批[FF3333]拥有独立姓名的宿敌[-]首领。
共6个宿敌阶级：[AAAAAA]低阶[-] | [44BBFF]高阶[-] | [44FF88]精英[-] | [FFCC33]冠军[-] | [FF8800]传奇[-] | [FF3333]世界级[-]

English: Each nemesis has a [FF8800]territory[-], a [FF3333]name[-] and a [FFCC33]title[-] (e.g. GRIMTOOTH the Butcher)
schinese: 每个宿敌都有自己的[FF8800]领地[-]、[FF3333]姓名[-]和[FFCC33]称号[-]（例如“屠夫”裂齿）。

English: Kill a nemesis enough times to permanently destroy it — then its slot refills with a new one
schinese: 多次击杀同一宿敌可将其永久消灭，空缺位置随后会由新的宿敌补充。
[FFD700]── 宿敌：仇恨与战争 ──[-]

English: Kill a nemesis → it holds a [FF3333]grudge[-]: it may hunt you down personally
schinese: 击杀宿敌后，它会对你怀有[FF3333]仇恨[-]，并可能亲自追猎你。

English: Kill an AEC boss → a related nemesis may swear [FF8800]revenge[-] against you
schinese: 击杀AEC 首领后，与其相关的宿敌可能发誓向你[FF8800]复仇[-]。

English: Periodically: nemesis [FFCC33]hierarchy wars[-] — the loser loses rank, the winner promotes
schinese: 宿敌会定期发动[FFCC33]阶层战争[-]：败者降级，胜者晋升。

English: Nemesis [44BBFF]migrate territories[-] over time — they may show up near your base
schinese: 宿敌会随时间[44BBFF]迁移领地[-]，因此也可能出现在你的基地附近。
